title: IntentObject
description: Validated intent passed from the Controller to the Privileged Brain. Never contains raw user text — only structured, schema-validated fields.

intent_id.description: Opaque UUID reference. This is the ONLY thing the Privileged Brain receives — never raw user text.

action.description: MCP tool name as 'module.method' (and 'module.submodule.method' — mcpd ships network.dns.read). One or more dot-separated lowercase segments, each starting with a letter; alphanumeric + underscore otherwise. Must match an entry in mcpd's tools/list catalogue.

target.description: Primary target of the action (e.g. path, service name, PID). Shell metacharacters are forbidden.

params.description: Tool-specific parameters. Validated against the tool's JSON Schema from mcpd.

content.description: Optional QB-produced verbatim payload for the intent (e.g. the exact bytes to write for fs.write). NOT a parameter — never interpolated into a command; PB is instructed to copy it into params.content unchanged. Newlines and other control chars are allowed here (unlike params values); NUL bytes are not.

pb_hint.description: Optional short natural-language coaching from QB to PB describing which tool-schema field carries the semantic payload and any format constraints (e.g. 'put the CSV data in params.content, exactly 5 lines each just the character 1'). PB is instructed to follow it before consulting its own training. Not interpolated into a command.

reason.description: Why this intent was generated. Affects audit log and HITL display.

risk_level.description: Risk tier. Determines HITL behavior: read_only/low=auto, medium=notify, high/critical=block+prompt.

schema_version.description: Version of the mcpd schema catalogue this intent was validated against.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the intent was created.
